programmes.school: School of Mechanical, Industrial, and Manufacturing Engineering
programmes.evidence: 2026–2027 graduate major explicitly includes Industrial Engineering PhD at Corvallis within actual MIME school. PhD-specific requirements total 108 credits, at least 48 coursework and 36–60 IE 603 thesis credits; research scope advances industrial/manufacturing systems, production planning, inventory/scheduling, quality and supply chains.
limitations: Optional transcript-visible Advanced Manufacturing, Engineering Management, Human Systems Engineering and Manufacturing Systems Engineering may be declared one or more; they are nested in this one IE award, not extra independent doctorates.
